findings.title: no-hsts: browser/transport hardening header

evidence.detail: No Strict-Transport-Security header found. Apply HSTS at the edge to ALL responses (`max-age>=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload` where the domain model allows) so the first-load page can't be downgraded over plaintext.

cwe: CWE-319 Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information

findings.remediation: Apply HSTS uniformly at the EDGE to ALL responses (not just /api): `max-age>=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload` where the domain model allows.
